data.name: Runeforger
data.description: A forgemaster may inscribe mystical runes upon a suit of armor, shield, or weapon as full-round action, using this ability %1 times per day. These runes last %2 rounds, but inscribing the same rune twice on an item increases this duration to %2 minutes, three times to %20 minutes, and four times to %2 hours. Erase affects runes as magical writing. Only one type of rune marked with an asterisk (*) may be placed on an item at any given time. This ability replaces channel energy.|3+INT|ClericLVL
